dashboard.subtitle: You're the bridge between your village and a specialist doctor. Symptom check, bookings, records — all from here.
dashboard.recent_empty: No bookings yet. Add your first villager.

roster.title: My villagers.
roster.subtitle: Light-touch profiles for the people in your care. Add, run a symptom check, book a doctor — all from one place.
roster.empty_body: Add your first villager to get started.

add.title: Add villager
add.subtitle: A light profile under your care. They don't need a smartphone.

consult.no_villager: No villager selected. Go back to the roster.
consult.triage_hint: Tap the mic — let the villager speak, or speak for them.

appointments.subtitle: Your upcoming visits and past consultations live here. Joining opens 5 minutes before your slot.
appointments.join_too_early: You can join 5 minutes before your slot.
appointments.expect_review: Doctor reviews your history before the call
appointments.expect_notes: You'll receive notes + prescription right after
appointments.expect_free_first: Free first visit — no card needed
appointments.no_upcoming_title: Nothing booked — that's a good day.
appointments.no_upcoming_body: When you need to see a specialist, the right doctor is two taps away. First consult is always on us.
appointments.empty_body: Pick a specialist below to book your first 30-minute video consult.

profile.password_set_hint: Choose something only you'd know. We recommend at least 10 characters with a mix of letters and a number.

doctors_page.subtitle_default: Browse verified doctors and book a 30-minute video consult at any open time. All bookings are free during early access.
doctors_page.subtitle_triage: These doctors match the specialty suggested by your symptom check. Pick a time that suits you.
doctors_page.empty_no_match_body: Try a different name or specialty.
doctors_page.empty_no_doctors_body: New specialists are onboarded by admins. Check back soon.

book_dialog.title: Book {{name}}
book_dialog.free_first_note: Your first MedDx consult is on us.
book_dialog.paid_note: ₹199 · 30-minute video consult. Paid via Razorpay (test mode).
book_dialog.no_slots_body: This doctor hasn't published availability — try another specialist or check back soon.

records.title: My records.
records.subtitle: Everything your MedDx doctors have approved and added to your chart. AI helps format these — only a licensed doctor can write them.
records.empty_body: Once you complete a video consult, the doctor's notes and prescription will appear here.

triage.page_subtitle: A quick AI-assisted triage. We never diagnose — we just suggest how urgent your case is and which kind of doctor to see.
triage.card_subtitle: Our triage assistant suggests an urgency level and the right specialist. It's not a diagnosis — a licensed doctor will see you on video.
triage.symptoms_placeholder: e.g. chest tightness for the last two hours, gets worse when I climb stairs, no recent injury
triage.duration_label: How long has this been going on?
triage.extra_placeholder: Allergies, recent medications, conditions you already manage
triage.disclaimer: This is not a diagnosis and won't appear in your medical record on its own. A licensed doctor on MedDx reviews every case on the video call.
triage.result_low_blurb: Likely self-limiting — book a routine consult when convenient.
triage.result_medium_blurb: You should see a doctor in the next 1–3 days.
triage.result_high_blurb: Try to book a same-day slot with the recommended specialist.
triage.result_emergency_blurb: Please contact local emergency services right now. Do not wait for an online consult.
triage.emergency_banner_body: Please call your local emergency number now (India: 112). MedDx can still book you a free urgent video consult below, but it is not a substitute for emergency care.
triage.mic_unsupported: Voice input isn't supported in this browser
triage.result_disclaimer: This triage is for guidance only. It is not a diagnosis or a substitute for a doctor. In a real emergency, contact local emergency services immediately.
